column1: # 0.0.2's mutants of the harness's checks -- each one facet of one check broken alone, by the edits of one name;
# `mutants.py` makes each edit exactly once in a copy of the tree's HEAD and runs the harness there. Two rows are
# controls the other way: `library-shapes-allowed` adds the library's own facets to `src/core/core.npk` and must stay
# GREEN, and `library-shapes-no-failsafe` shows the allowance B-2 gives a module compiled alone is what keeps it so.
# TAB-separated: name, file, the text replaced, its replacement; `\n` is a newline and `\t` a tab.
